name: MACDWaterlineCrossExpectator
summary: This EA trades based on MACD crossing its zero (water) line, expecting momentum continuation after the crossover. It opens buy positions when MACD crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below zero, using the signal line crossover as confirmation or timing mechanism. The strategy is a classic momentum approach that capitalizes on shifts between bullish and bearish momentum regimes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD跨越零线（水面）进行交易，预期交叉后动量将持续。当MACD上穿零线时开多仓，下穿零线时开空仓，利用信号线交叉作为确认或时机选择。这是一个经典的动量策略，旨在捕捉多空动量转换的时刻。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是MACD零线交叉，即MACD指标从负转正或从正转负时，代表市场动量方向发生了根本性转变。入场条件为MACD上穿零线时做多，MACD下穿零线时做空，部分变体可能结合信号线交叉作为额外确认以减少假信号。出场条件通常包括反向零线交叉平仓、固定止盈止损、或基于ATR的动态止损机制。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，由于MACD零线交叉属于中长周期信号，持仓时间可能较长，因此需要合理的止损设置来控制单笔风险。策略的弱点在于震荡市中MACD会频繁穿越零线导致连续假突破和亏损，因此趋势过滤器或波动率过滤器的加入对策略表现至关重要。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is the MACD zero-line crossover, which signals a fundamental shift in market momentum direction when MACD transitions from negative to positive or vice versa. Entry conditions are buying when MACD crosses above zero and selling when it crosses below zero, with some variants potentially using signal line crossovers as additional confirmation to reduce false signals. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse zero-line crossovers, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or ATR-based dynamic stop mechanisms. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or proportional sizing based on account balance. Money management requires reasonable stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk since MACD zero-line crossovers generate medium-to-long-term signals with potentially extended holding periods. The strategy's weakness lies in choppy markets where MACD frequently oscillates around zero, generating consecutive false breakouts and losses, making trend or volatility filters critical for strategy performance.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; 0 disables TP

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，MACD零线交叉是经典且广为认可的技术分析方法
捕捉中长期趋势转换点，在趋势明显的市场中表现良好
参数较少，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用和学习
入场信号客观明确，不存在主观判断的模糊性
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on the classic and widely recognized MACD zero-line crossover technique
Captures medium-to-long-term trend reversal points, performing well in strongly trending markets
Few parameters make it easy to understand and tune, suitable for beginners to learn from
Objective and unambiguous entry signals eliminate subjective judgment ambiguity
cons: 在震荡市中MACD频繁穿越零线导致大量假信号和连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分趋势行情和区间震荡行情
默认止损可能为0，存在无限亏损的风险敞口
MACD零线交叉属于滞后信号，入场时趋势可能已走完大半
未考虑点差和滑点影响，在短线场景下成本可能吞噬利润
cons_en: MACD frequently crosses zero in choppy markets, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish trending markets from range-bound conditions
Default stop-loss may be zero, creating an unlimited risk exposure
MACD zero-line crossover is a lagging signal, often entering after a significant portion of the move has already occurred
Does not account for spread and slippage impacts, which can erode profits in short-term scenarios
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线）以在震荡市中抑制交易
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动率
加入新K线检查机制，避免在同一根K线上重复开仓
增加点差过滤，避免在高点差环境下入场
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe moving average) to suppress trading in choppy markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated trade openings on the same candle
Add spread filtering to avoid entering trades during high-spread conditions

risk_points: 默认止损可能为0，单笔交易风险无上限
震荡市中频繁假信号导致连续亏损
未检测是否有新K线形成，可能重复开仓
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能过度开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss may be zero, creating unlimited per-trade risk
Frequent false signals in choppy markets lead to consecutive losses
No new bar detection, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
No position count check, risk of over-opening positions

The strategy is a classic momentum approach that capitalizes on shifts between bullish and bearish momentum regimes.
